Andrea (All-hands): Following up from the all-hands reliability segment — sharing the RCA link and a short owner/action list we agreed on. Please ack and add your tasks to INC-2057 with tag post-allhands.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2057 closed. RCA + timeline: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2057/timeline and https://docs.redwood.com/rca/inc-2057-2026-06-04.

Maria (SRE): Root cause: allocator edge-case + prefix churn -> eviction stall -> request queue growth -> transient 504s. No customer data exposure.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/498. Plan: staging canary 06:00 UTC tomorrow, 3% ramp for 4h, then prod ramp if clean. Owner: Jamal.

Leo (Eng Platform): I'll prototype fallback automation (feature flag + queued reroute) and a short playbook for on-call. Owner: Leo + eng-platform. ETA: 2 weeks.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll draft customer-facing note + impacted tenant table. Need final tenant list from SREs. ETA: Mon 14:00 UTC.

Andrea (All-hands): Action list I'm adding to INC-2057: 1) Hotfix & canary (Jamal) due tomorrow AM. 2) Eviction/mem alert + runbook (Maria) due Wed. 3) Fallback automation spike (Leo) due in 2w. 4) Customer note + table (Priya) due Mon 14:00. 5) CI regression for allocation churn (Eng Runtime) next sprint.

Maria (SRE): Added alert + first-pass runbook to ops-repo. Will iterate after canary.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): ✅ Hotfix merged, running stress. Will post deploy link after staging rollout.

Priya (Customer Success): ✅ Draft started, pinging SREs for tenant list.

Ryan (CTO): Thanks all. Keep updates concise in INC-2057. We'll do a 20m check-in Thu 09:30 UTC to confirm progress.

Andrea (All-hands): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've added the INC-2057 tasks and tagged post-allhands. Closing here unless new updates come in before Thu sync.
